title: Log-Concave Counterfactual Density Contrasts at the Vanishing-Curvature Quartic Transition

Retained endpoint height laws, uniform projection rates, knot noncollapse/contact brackets, and a distinct honest smooth-pilot wrapper J_n, while mixed selection and law-calibrated I_n remain open. tldr: On the entire controlled finite-stratum benchmark, the prescribed original-record log-concave projection has a uniform transition-scale error bound, actual-knot tightness and noncollapse, and endpoint fitted-height laws. Uniform approximation holds on shrinking endpoint neighborhoods; a signed quadratic causal contrast law holds when one quadratic arm dominates the contrast scale. The explicit connected interval \(J_n\), centered at the fitted contrast, has finite-sample coverage at least \(0.90\) and uniformly bounded transition-scale length. Interior mixed height selection, the actual-nearest-knot law, certified continuum computation and law-calibrated \(I_n\) remain unresolved. The benchmark does not assert applicability to the motivating earnings data.
